source_snapshot.procedure: Use iPerf for Ethernet and Mellanox ib_write_bw for IB.
source_snapshot.criteria: Bandwidth matches SPEC; explicitly confirm1G LAN.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL covers Ethernet only with unsafe untracked process handling.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires applicable branch matrix, peers, tool/profile/topology/thresholds, isolation and cleanup.

old_problem: Ethernet and IB branches lacked applicability, topology and thresholds; DeepSeek silently dropped IB coverage.
disposition_reason: ED-05 requires Ethernet and InfiniBand to be validated separately, so no branch may substitute for the other. Installed/applicable ports, peers and thresholds are project bindings; both branch definitions can be completed fail closed, with1G LAN always retained where present.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row51 all18 XLSX cells and history2663.
Preserved distinct iperf and ib_write_bw semantics plus explicit1G LAN coverage.
Rejected DeepSeek's Ethernet-only output and untracked broad process cleanup; no network test ran.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized separate Ethernet and InfiniBand bandwidth validation
test_case.purpose: Measure each applicable Ethernet and InfiniBand path with its protocol-appropriate peer tool and compare branch-specific sustained throughput with approved specifications.
required_package: Applicable-port matrix with Ethernet netdev/MAC/BDF and IB HCA/port/GID mapping
Dedicated peer and isolated non-management physical path for each branch
Pinned iperf3 and rdma-core/perftest versions on both endpoints
IB QP/message-size/MTU/GID/direction/duration profile and threshold plus abort/cleanup policy
test_case.test_command: For each applicable Ethernet target, validate mapping/peer/isolation, run tracked iperf3 server/client in every approved direction/profile, and capture interval/final throughput/errors. Separately for each applicable IB target, validate active link/GID/peer, run the approved ib_write_bw server/client profile, and capture bandwidth/counters. Stop only owned PIDs and compare each branch solely to its matched specification.
test_case.expected_result: Every applicable Ethernet and IB branch completes its own profile, meets the approved sustained-throughput tolerance and shows no link, transport, driver or platform error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires branch-applicability evidence, correct tool/profile, complete result and approved threshold for every required branch. Ethernet cannot cover IB, IB cannot cover Ethernet, and1G LAN cannot be omitted.
safety_gate: Use dedicated non-management paths and approved peers.
Verify netdev/BDF or HCA/port/GID immediately before load.
Avoid broad pkill; track exact server/client processes.
Abort on management impact, link loss, driver/transport error, thermal/power limit or peer mismatch; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Tool versions and exact branch commands
Ethernet per-direction interval/final throughput and errors
IB bandwidth, QP/GID/link and port counters
Branch-matched thresholds, health logs and owned-process cleanup
test_case.recovery: If a branch loses link or saturates an unintended path, stop only that branch's tracked endpoints, preserve interface/HCA/route/GID/counter evidence, restore the recorded interface state, verify management remains reachable, and require network-owner review before another load.

source_conflict.reason: ED-05 mandates separate branches; applicability and thresholds are fail-closed bindings rather than a choice that deletes coverage.

blocked.reason: Review is complete; peers, mappings, profiles and thresholds gate execution.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Bind applicable branches, port/peer topology, profiles, thresholds, isolation and recovery.

project_authority: Applicability, topology, profiles and throughput limits are project-specific inputs.
